name: firstcontact
description: A welcoming, open-source bridge between overlooked founders and thoughtful investors worldwide.

scripts.api:dev: cd services/api && uv --cache-dir /tmp/firstcontact-uv-cache run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:worker: cd services/api && uv --cache-dir /tmp/firstcontact-uv-cache run python -m app.worker
scripts.api:dispatch: cd services/api && uv --cache-dir /tmp/firstcontact-uv-cache run python -m app.worker --once
scripts.api:check: cd services/api && uv --cache-dir /tmp/firstcontact-uv-cache run ruff check app tests && uv --cache-dir /tmp/firstcontact-uv-cache run mypy app tests && uv --cache-dir /tmp/firstcontact-uv-cache run pytest
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --incremental false && vitest run && eslint . && next build

//overrides: Transitive dependencies of next/vite/eslint carrying known-high advisories, forced to their fixed releases rather than suppressed in the audit. Remove an entry once the parent package requires the fixed version itself.
//dependencies: Pinned to exact versions on purpose: a fresh `bun install` without the lockfile must resolve to the versions CI verified, and Dependabot proposes upgrades as reviewable PRs instead of them arriving silently.
